q: "Alas! I have lost my wallet," he exclaimed.
o: He exclaimed with sorrow that he had lost his wallet.
He exclaimed alas that he had lost his wallet.
He exclaimed that he lost his wallet.
Exclaimed with grief he said that he had lost his wallet.
e: Exclamatory বাক্যের indirect speech করতে reporting verb বদলে যায়: আনন্দ বোঝালে exclaimed with joy, দুঃখ বোঝালে exclaimed with sorrow বা grief। এরপর inverted comma-র জায়গায় that বসে, reported speech-এর subject থাকে, আর verb-এর কাল অতীতের নিয়মে বদলায়। Alas! দুঃখ বোঝায়, তাই He exclaimed with sorrow that he had lost his wallet শুদ্ধ। Alas শব্দটি indirect-এ অবিকল রাখা বা কাল না বদলানো ভুল।

q: He has said to me, “I shall go out but you will stay.” Make it indirect speech.
o: He has told me that he would go out but I should stay
He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay
He told me that he will go out but I shall stay
He has said me that he would go out but I would stay
e: Reporting verb present perfect (has said) হলে reported speech-এর tense বদলায় না, শুধু person বদলায়। Said to হয়ে যায় told, তাই “has told me”। “I shall go” এর I হয় he, আর “you will stay” এর you হয় আমি (me-এর person অনুযায়ী) I। ফলে সঠিক রূপ: He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay। অর্থ: সে আমাকে বলেছে সে বাইরে যাবে কিন্তু আমি থাকব।
